invariants.rationale: The method uses nodes.size and nodes.get(i), so nodes must not be null for safe execution.
Array.size in libGDX is an integer representing the count of elements, which can't be negative.
Array.items is the underlying data array; used by get(), so must be non-null if size > 0.
By libGDX Array contract, size cannot be greater than the items array's length.
